lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 12-14 distinct vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, showing a regular geometric spacing with smaller, more densely packed clusters localized near the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a consistent grid-like pattern where high-luminance nodes are centered within the vertical band intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally across the dorsal-lateral transition, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral) along the ridge axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-15 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed unevenly within the dorsal fin silhouette, with a higher concentration near the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned along the ventral midline and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
